post:
**The bread doesn't care how you feel.**

At four every morning, my father had me kneading dough before school. Every day, even in winter.

It taught me that showing up matters more than talent.

- You get there.
- You do the work.

Years later, running my own team at the plant, I told the young engineers the same thing.

What's a lesson you learned before you were old enough to know it was one?
